content.title: It’s Time to Tune In to Coachella—Here’s How to Watch the Livestream
content.text: Samantha OlsonFri, April 10, 2026 at 12:47 p.m. CDT9 min readHere’s How to Watch Every Coachella PerformanceGetty ImagesFestival season is in full swing, and, of course, things kick off with one of the most iconic events in pop culture: Coachella. Naturally, a bunch of Cosmo faves are part of this year’s stacked lineup, including headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Karol G, and Justin Bieber. From up-and-comers to seasoned veterans and Grammy nominees, all types of artists are performing over two weekends in Indio. Slayyyter, Addison Rae, Sombr, PinkPantheress, and KATSEYE are only a few of the acts making their desert debuts this year, and I can’t wait to see them tear up the stage.If you’re already feeling FOMO from music’s biggest festival, don’t fret. Every single performance is officially being livestreamed on YouTube, starting on Friday, April 10—and I’ve got the whole schedule and livestream links right here so you don’t miss a beat. There’s no way you’re missing Bieberchella, diva!!Getty ImagesHow to watch the 2026 Coachella livestreamThis year’s Coachella livestream will take place on YouTube starting at 4 p.m. PT / 7 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10. Each set will be available to stream during both weekends of the famous music festival, which takes place from April 10–12 and April 17–19.Performances will be streamed at different links for each
